output.obligation: Identify the building that the founder of a company whose online video games division released a video game between 2000 and 2010 that was considered one of the top-earning games of all time at least until 2019, and who graduated from a university founded between 1930 and 1970, together with their spouse who as of 2019 had no children from the marriage, made a foundational gift to construct; this building was part of a larger complex and, as of 2019, was scheduled to open between 2018 and 2021 and was part of a specific university.
